info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Labels API provides a streamlined way to access and list shipping labels for various logistics operations. This API allows users to retrieve comprehensive information about labels associated with shipments, which is essential for tracking and documentation purposes. Ideal for logistics managers and shipping coordinators, the API facilitates the efficient management of shipment labels, enabling better oversight and coordination in the shipping process. Whether integrating with transportation management systems or enhancing logistics workflows, this API plays a critical role in optimizing shipment visibility.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the label associated with a specific shipment. It provides the relevant shipping details and can be used for tracking and verification purposes.

requestBody.description: Contains the parameters necessary to generate a shipment label. This request expects a JSON payload with specific details regarding the shipment.

ListLogisticsShipmentsLabelsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on shipments label. It is expected to contain a string that describes the request.
